POD-IF-GNSS-ANTENNA: NOT CHECKED: NEO-M9N RF_IN to SMA targets 50 ohm coplanar routing on F.Cu over In1.Cu GND using JLC04161H-7628. Impedance remains unverified: a captured calculator result is not actual board impedance verification. The anonymous host workflow at https://jlcpcb.com/pcb-impedance-calculator/ made three W1 calculation submissions with solver status 6 and null geometry; HTTP acceptance is not a successful calculation. The single authorized W2 continuation returned solver status 0 and valid geometry with attempt 3 physical inputs preserved. See rf-source-capture.json for raw request/result identities and hashes. Source-derived RF_50 lower W1 width 0.334416796875 mm and clearance 0.2032 mm are declared in rf-net-constraints.json; upper W2 width 0.321716796875 mm is retained separately. The existing emitter rounds the planar width minimum upward to 0.335 mm and keeps impedance recorded_not_enforced. Native minimum width and clearance checks cannot establish exact coplanar gap, solder mask, return geometry or impedance. RF maximum length remains unbound without a captured design bound; 15 mm is a test value only. A complete pinout and captured electrical contracts are also required before hardware_interface can cover this interface; physical and firmware performance remains unverified.
